verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents a synchronous webhook that delivers authorization requests in real time so you can approve or decline them, and the agents page cites real-time authorization decisioning. That shows webhook-based event delivery exists, but only for this one event flow. Missing for 10: documentation of general event subscription (event catalog, endpoint registration for card/cardholder/transaction events), delivery guarantees such as retries and signature verification, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
